definitions.definition: The user is added directly to the current group or project.
The user is a member of a parent group that contains the current group or project.
The user is a member of a group invited to the current group or project.
The user is a member of a group invited to an ancestor of the current group or project.

common_rule: For group-based approvals, only direct members of the group can approve merge requests. Inherited members of the eligible groups cannot provide approvals.
